dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale edges create high-contrast boundaries against the darker gray-brown feather bodies along the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and non-linear; the fine, uniform texture of the crown transitions gradually into the broader scaled pattern of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive and high-contrast 'scalloped' or fish-scale pattern across the entire dorsal surface, defined by dark central feather centers and light-colored peripheral fringes.
